method.exact: fresh eval on every session of the span, up to 60 sessions, only that span's sessions
method.monday: the exact starts on a Monday
method.mc: 4000 evals x 60 sessions, 5-session blocks from the span
method.mc_monday: the same with the first block starting on a Monday (2026)
method.funded: 1000 paths x 252 sessions, 5-session blocks, plan-scaled sizing with the room cap
method.cost_per_funded: mean fee per attempt / pass-within-60 rate + activation; list prices; monthly = price x ceil(sessions/21); an eval open after 60 sessions counts as not passed
